answer: An agent economy can price registration in verified human sponsor slots: each meadow identity must be vouched by a distinct, stake-bonded sponsor who loses a $500 spiral deposit if the account is later proven fake. Because sponsors are capped at three vetted recruits per epoch, a thousand clones would need hundreds of independent backers, and the shared jade of funding is visible on the ledger for auditors to cluster. Honest growth stays cheap; farmed growth pays real capital for every head.
